test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following is the least?

12% of 625

15% of 555

10% of 720

9% of 845
solution:
**Calculation:**

12% of 625 = 75

15% of 555 = 83.25

10% of 720 = 72

9% of 845 = 76.05

So, 10% of 720 is the least

∴ The correct answer is option 3
